name: Nongkhnum River Island
description: Largest river island in Meghalaya (about 21 sq km), formed by the bifurcation of the Kynshi River into Phanliang and Namliang branches. Features sandy beaches, clear waters, and nearby waterfalls; often promoted as Asia’s second-largest river island. Quiet picnic, camping and nature spot near Nongstoin.
facts: Located about 14 km from Nongstoin, HQ of West Khasi Hills
Area approximately 21 km²; formed by Kynshi River split
Contains or adjacent to Weinia Falls and views of Langshiang Falls
Low tourist infrastructure; ideal for peaceful nature visits
Sources: Wikipedia, westkhasihills.gov.in

name: Langshiang Falls
description: Dramatic plunge waterfall on the Kynshi River near Sangriang village, about 24 km from Nongstoin. Height generally quoted around 337 m (1,106 ft), making it one of the taller falls in India and Meghalaya. Offers panoramic views of green hills and gorges; accessible by short walk from village.
facts: Coordinates 25°26′43″N 91°13′43″E; height ~337 m (unconfirmed exact)
Also known as Kshaid Ur-Nar; near Mawpon village viewpoint
About 24-25 km from Nongstoin; 30-minute walk from Sangriang
Part of Kynshi River system around Nongkhnum Island
Sources: Wikipedia, official district references

name: Weinia Falls (Kshaid Weinia)
description: Impressive waterfall near Nongkhnum Island on the Kynshi system, cascading through rocky cliffs into a pool. Popular for photography and nature immersion; about 15 km from Nongstoin. Often listed among top attractions of West Khasi Hills.
facts: Located on or near Nongkhnum River Island area
About 15 km from Nongstoin via Nongkhnum Road
Surrounded by dense forest and rocky gorges
Approx coordinates based on proximity to Nongkhnum (25.444, 91.253); verify locally
Sources: local tourism reports, district site

name: Nongstoin
description: Headquarters and main town of West Khasi Hills district, situated at about 1,409 m elevation. Serves as the administrative and transport gateway to Nongkhnum Island, Langshiang Falls and other western attractions. Markets, churches and basic amenities for travelers.
facts: Elevation ~1409 m; population ~28,742 (2011)
Coordinates approx 25.517°N, 91.265°E (Wikipedia/GeoNames)
About 90-100 km from Shillong
Base for exploring West Khasi Hills tourism circuit
Sources: Wikipedia
